description:
IRREVERSIBLE: Delete a batch calling campaign

Deletes a campaign and its recipient rows permanently. Only a campaign that was never submitted, or one that has since been cancelled or failed, can be deleted: a submitted campaign in any other state is refused with 409 and has to be cancelled first. Deleting removes the recipient history along with the campaign, so export anything you need from the recipients endpoint before calling this. The response is a bare confirmation message with no `success` field, and the operation uses the `write:agents` scope rather than a scope of its own.

confirm.description: Leave out on the first call. EchoCall then answers with a confirmation value. Ask the user for a clear yes, then repeat the call with the same arguments and this value.
